title: Correct stale correction-lineage claim in round77 hosted review template
body:
An independent pre-execution review found a minor stale statement in the round77 hosted-review helper's proposed PASS comment: it claimed an “explicit operational-review correction lineage” inherited from a prior cohort. At the time of the finding, the round77 helper audit contained no corrective findings or correction pair. An adjacent module comment had the same stale scope.

This is a reporting/provenance defect in an unexecuted comment template, not a scientific-record or runtime-guard defect. No inaccurate comment was posted. The initial observation HP1 and exact source snapshots are preserved in `cmm-round77-hosted-helper-static-20261014T173103Z` and will be retained in the PR publication-review artifacts.

Acceptance criteria:

- Replace the two stale prose statements with wording matching the actual round77 package and issue dispositions.
- Preserve the initial observation, before/after source hashes, and an independent successor explicitly resolving HP1.
- Verify that behavioral guards are unchanged and the eventual posted COMMENT matches the corrected, reviewed template at the exact PR head.

The local correction is under independent review; this issue will close through the reviewed PR after the correction artifacts are committed. No record or history edit is needed.
